subject: System
action: The previous and next chapter links must navigate to the neighboring chapter only when that adjacent chapter is available; otherwise the corresponding link must be disabled.
condition: While the current chapter has no previous chapter or no next chapter in the TOC.
expectedOutcome: Readers cannot navigate past the available chapter boundaries.

subject: System
action: On mount, the reader must call chapter-open tracking for every open, and it must upsert reading_progress only when the chapter is not locked and a user exists.
condition: When the chapter reader mounts for a chapter open.
expectedOutcome: Every open increments chapter views, while reading progress is written only for unlocked chapters with an authenticated user.

subject: System
action: The screen must fall through to notFound() when either the public work or the public chapter is missing.
condition: If the reader route resolves without a public work or without a public chapter.
expectedOutcome: The chapter reading experience is not rendered and the request falls through to notFound().

subject: System
action: The reader must render the centered payment-preparation message instead of chapter.content when the chapter is locked.
expectedOutcome: Readers see the locked-state message rather than the chapter body.

subject: System
action: When the reader opens or submits 신고, the reporting flow must enforce login checks, and it must reject submissions that choose 기타 without detailed content.
condition: When a reader opens or submits a report from the 보기 설정 flow.
expectedOutcome: Reporting stays gated behind authentication and requires extra detail for the 기타 reason.

subject: System
action: Font size changes must stay within 17, 19, 21, and 24, and theme changes must stay within light, sepia, and dark.
expectedOutcome: Readers can choose only the supported reading presentation options.

action: Read a public chapter and control the reading experience
